references.text: Continuation of the law concerning a skin disease that has spread over the entire body, where the priest is to declare the person clean
The initial description of how the priest is to examine skin diseases and assess the rash
The ritual for cleansing a person who has been healed from a skin disease
Reference to leprosy and a reminder to follow the priests' instructions carefully
Miriam was struck with leprosy that covered her entire body, a parallel to the description of a disease spreading from head to foot
Naaman's leprosy was transferred to Gehazi and his descendants, an example of skin disease in the OT
Jesus heals a man full of leprosy and sends him to the priest to follow the Mosaic law regarding cleansing
